name: Aire Tributary Sawtooth II Tandem Inflatable Kayak
description: The Aire Tributary Sawtooth II Inflatable Kayak is a perfect craft for paddling on lakes, bays and easy rivers. Introduced due to the popularity of the single version, the Aire Tributary Sawtooth II Inflatable Kayak includes two seats that can be repositioned. The second seat can be removed entirely to make room for more gear on those long trips. Paddling a straight course is simple with the removable skeg and ribbed floor chambers. The Airecell system improves performance and durability using 1670 denier base PVC coated fabric to decrease the chance of tears.

Constructed from high-density polyethylene plastic for light weight, durability, and low maintenance. The hull design provides ultimate stability so you can even stand up while fishing! description: With the Excursion 10 fishing kayak you can get up-close and personal when catching those big winners. adjustable, padded seat 1 swivel and 2 flush mount rod holders large, open cockpit area removable portable accessory carrier adjustable foot braces with protective thigh pads convenient water bottle holder shock cord deck rigging 250-lb. max. weight capacity 120x30x13"H; 41 lbs. durable polyethylene construction wipe clean made in America

name: Ocean Kayak Frenzy Kayak
description: The Ocean Kayak Frenzy Kayak performs well on surf, tight rivers, and flat water due to it's short length and built in keel. The Frenzy kayak is stable enough for beginning paddlers, but spunky enough to provide years of fun on a variety of water types. It is outfitted with a Comfort Plus seat, a skid plate, as well as hard plastic side carry handles.

name: Field & Stream Shadow Caster 123 Angler Kayak, Green
description: Paddle to where the fish are biting with the Field & Stream® Shadow Caster Angler Kayak. Easy to maneuver with plenty of space and stability for standing while on the water, the Shadow Caster is perfect for fishing and rec paddling alike. The no-slip decking and stand assist strap are ideal for your sporting needs, while the paddle parks and stern storage add key features to round out this Field & Stream® kayak for many seasons to come! FEATURES: 1-person sit-on-top kayak Designed for fishing and recreational paddling Pontoon design Patent pending Lift Link seat raises 5" off the deck and flips back for additional standing room Tri-hull design delivers tracking and maneuverability Built-in bow and stern handles deliver durability and strength Durable construction provides stability on the water Twist-lock foot pegs for quick adjustments while paddling Two universally compatible 33" accessory tracks Non-slip deck Stand assist strap for casting out Two flush mount rod holders located behind the seat Two paddle parks Stern storage well fits a standard 12" x 12" milk crate plus extra gear Double twist-lock hatch provides waterproof protection for your gear SPECS: Length: 123" Maximum weight capacity: 450 lbs. Kayak weight: 95 lbs. Size: 12 FT. 3 IN.. Color: Forest. Gender: Unisex.

name: Perception Pescador 12.0 Pilot Kayak Sunset, One Size
description: Granting you access to hidden pools and willow-laced river banks, the Perception Pescador 12. 0 Pilot Kayak ensures dependable stability and comfort as you embark upon a full day of fishing. Built for mellow and slightly rough waters alike, the Pescador features a multi-chine hull, broad shoulder, and straight tracking keel, in turn offering a maneuverability that's dependable, stable, and adaptive. The Comfort Seating System is adjustable for your convenience, allowing you to customize your fit and preference, while the foot brace ensures proper posture when paddling. Multiple hatches ensure that you're able to bring along all of the necessities, and an open tankwell provides fast and easy storage for items such as a cooler.

name: Old Town Predator MX Sit-on-Top Fishing Kayak Camouflage
description: This highly engineered Sit-on-Top Fishing Kayak is packed with features that make it perfect for hunting fish in moving water. Stable deck with assist strap lets you stand while fishing, allowing greater vision so you can see more fish. Polyethylene Tri-Hull is durable, strong and straight tracking. Slip-resistant Exo-Ridge textured deck for standing. Super-stable, with assist strap so you can stand up to cast. Element Seating Systems three positions: Travel for paddling, Attack for fishing and Stand-Up. Six mounting plates eliminate the need to drill holes to attach accessories. Large bow hatch with convenient Click Seal cover keeps gear secure and dry. Exo-Ridge tankwell fits a cooler, trolling motor battery or tackle boxes. Eight scupper holes with patented one-way valves drain water. Side-mount paddle storage and molded paddle-rest free up hands for casting. Dual rod tip holders at the bow protect rods while paddling. Rounder hull than Predator 13 is optimized for moving-water conditions. Seatback angle is adjustable. Support Track Foot Brace System is easy to adjust and comfortable. Molded-in carry handles in bow and stern. Two recessed carry handles at midpoints. Made in the USA.

name: Pelican Premium Athena 100X Kayak Purple Haze 10 Ft
description: Blending comfort, durability, performance and a lightweight, women-specific design, the sleek and nimble Pelican Premium Athena 100X kayak is stable and easy to paddle. See you on the water!
